brief:
Israeli voters may punish Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu over his failure to act on intelligence warnings before the October 7, 2023 attacks, Al Jazeera English reported. Netanyahu is said to have received advance alerts but did not respond in time to prevent the assault that killed hundreds of Israelis and triggered the ongoing war in Gaza.

The issue has emerged as a potential flashpoint in Israeli politics ahead of electoral contests, with public anger over the government's preparedness before the attacks fueling criticism of Netanyahu's leadership.
dek: Netanyahu is reported to have received warnings before October 7, 2023, but failed to act on time.
title: Netanyahu faces voter backlash over pre-October 7 security warnings
